This '''Unidentified Czerka Corporation warehouse''' was run by a [[Unidentified Czerka Corporation warehouse manager|manager]] who was a friend of [[Yuka Laka]]. The manager sold the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[HK-47]] from the warehouse to Laka because of the manager's debt.
